name: Suki x Sayonara
source:
-- Momoka  
“One more time… just one more time, the days with the one I loved begin again.  
Yes, so that we can say goodbye…”  

Momoka, who lost her life in a car accident, lingers in the world of the living, unable to move on.  
One day, a young man—Shunsuke—visits her.  
The two, who were once deeply in love, reunite. But what awaits them is…  

-- Rio  
“The feeling of ‘love’ is simple, yet complicated…  
So, goodbye, my love. And from now on…”  

Rio, Shunsuke’s childhood friend, has been worried about him.  
After the death of his lover, Rio tries to cheer up the grieving Shunsuke with a smile.  
But she begins to notice the feelings she once suppressed resurfacing…  

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/7326]freem[/url]]
translation:
——桃花  
“再一次……再一次，与我所爱的人在一起的日子又开始了。
是的，这样我们就可以告别了……”  

因车祸丧生的桃花，在人世间徘徊，无法前行。
有一天，一位年轻人——俊介——来看望她。
曾经深爱的两人再次重逢。但等待他们的却是……  

——里约  
“‘爱’的感觉很简单，但也很复杂……  
那么，再见，我的爱人。并且从现在开始……”  

俊介的儿时好友里奥一直很担心他。
爱人去世后，里约试图用微笑让悲伤的俊介振作起来。
但她开始注意到她曾经压抑的感情重新浮现……  

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/7326]freem[/url]]
